data.text: Kate’s plan has my support. I learned to fish here from my family, and I want our village to keep earning from this lake for years. Luke, I appreciate your offer, but you shouldn’t have to go without income. Ten tons each gives us the largest total catch we can repeat every month while keeping the lake full. I’ll commit to 10 tons this month and propose that we check the revealed catches together before agreeing on next month. John, can you join us on that?
